# HEARTz

> In-browser acoustic frequency player, binaural soundscapes, and 432 Hz audio converter.

HEARTz is a client-side web audio platform engineered for focus, meditation, and acoustic retuning. Audio processing runs locally in the browser via the Web Audio API with zero cloud audio uploads.

## Core Features & Tools
- [432 Hz Song Converter](https://heartz.app/#features): Client-side pitch retuning from standard concert pitch (A4 = 440 Hz) to Verdi tuning (A4 = 432 Hz) with lossless 16-bit 48 kHz WAV export.
- [Frequency Laboratory](https://heartz.app/#features): 0.01 Hz precision sine tone synthesizer with binaural amplitude modulation (including 432 Hz, 528 Hz, and 7.83 Hz Schumann resonance).
- [Guided Soundscapes](https://heartz.app/#features): Curated acoustic noise environments (binaural brown noise, pink noise, ocean soundscapes) with click-free volume fades.
- [Acoustic Audio Console](https://heartz.app/#demo-player): Interactive browser player with real-time oscilloscope waveform visualizer.
- [Privacy Architecture](https://heartz.app/#privacy): 100% on-device audio decoding, processing, and encoding; source audio files never leave the user device.

## Application Links
- [Open HEARTz Application](https://app.heartz.app/): Main application workspace.
- [Audio Converter Tool](https://app.heartz.app/converter): Direct link to song converter.
- [Frequency Lab Tool](https://app.heartz.app/frequency-lab): Direct link to pure tone generator.
- [Guided Sessions](https://app.heartz.app/guided): Pre-configured soundscapes.
- [User Library](https://app.heartz.app/library): Locally stored custom audio presets (IndexedDB).
